description: Default ~10 credits (limit 10; 1/result). Newest posts from a public Facebook group — caption, author, engagement, sortBy; 1 credit per post. Costs ~10 credits (1/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max posts to return (default 10, max 200; up to 80 per call — above that you get 80 with truncatedReason per-call-cap). Billed 1 credit per returned post, minimum 2.

sortBy.description: TOP_POSTS | RECENT_ACTIVITY | CHRONOLOGICAL (default) | CHRONOLOGICAL_LISTINGS. Maps to Facebook sorting_setting.

url.description: Public Facebook group URL, e.g. https://facebook.com/groups/ID. Must contain /groups/ — profile/page URLs are a definitive 400 (use /v1/facebook/profile-posts for those). The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: facebook_group_posts
title: Facebook Group Posts
